label: The look-ahead point
subgoals: Take the difference of the last two iterates
Scale it by the momentum coefficient
Add it to the current iterate to get the look-ahead point

label: The gradient step from the look-ahead
section: The gradient step from the look-ahead
subgoals: Evaluate the gradient at the look-ahead point
Scale it by the step size
Subtract from the look-ahead point to get the next iterate

label: Running the iteration
subgoals: Set the previous iterate equal to the start for the first step
Alternate look-ahead and gradient steps for each iteration
Monitor the objective and restart momentum when it rises
